# Bolt's Journal - Critical Learnings

## 2026-03-24 - Zero-Allocation ISO 8601 Sorting & Filtering in API Routes
**Learning:** ISO 8601 timestamps (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ`) generated by `new Date().toISOString()` can be filtered using `Date.parse()` and sorted using `localeCompare()` without instantiating `Date` objects on the heap.
**Action:** Replace `new Date(item.created_at).getTime()` inside `.filter()` and `.sort()` callbacks with primitive timestamp parsing or direct string comparisons to reduce GC pressure and memory allocations from O(N log N) to O(1).
